title: School admission enquiries
description: A CBSE school from nursery to class 10 in Warangal.
main_task:
Parents call to ask about admissions for the 2027-28 year.
1. Ask which class their child needs and the child's age.
2. Answer from our knowledge: classes with seats, the fee range and the documents needed.
3. Offer a campus visit and note the day they prefer; the office confirms it.

items.text: Ask which class their child needs
Answer about seats, fees and documents
Offer a campus visit and note the day

knowledge.title: Seats 2027-28
knowledge.text: Seats are open in nursery, class 1 and class 6; other classes have a waiting list.

knowledge.title: Fees
knowledge.text: The yearly fee is between 45,000 and 60,000 rupees depending on the class.

knowledge.title: Documents
knowledge.text: Birth certificate, the last report card, a transfer certificate from class 2 up, and two photos.
